findings.mechanism: Every site energyShare becomes 0 when total Wh is zero; effective-site count becomes raw bucket count and top dependency becomes session frequency. Stats marks all metrics available solely from nonempty sites. Energy-weighted help/axis names do not disclose this denominator switch. Zero remaining energy forces what-if newTop=null and scoreAfter=0 even if a bucket remains.
findings.repro: SOURCE WALKTHROUGH ONLY, not executed: successfully returned one A and one B session, both total_energy_added_wh=0. Chart shares=0%/0%, effective count=2, dependency=50%, fallback=50%, score=Math.round(100*(.4*.5+.3*.5+.3*.25))=43. What-if shows 0 Wh at risk, None yet for new top, after=0 and delta=-43 although another bucket remains. Undefined energy shares are presented alongside unqualified fallback resilience values.
findings.fix: Explicitly disclose unavailable energy denominator and any session-based fallback, distinguishing no remaining sites from no remaining recorded energy. Preserve raw Wh, sites/counts, positive-energy formulas and section shells; domain/presentation owner decision required.
